what_differs: The 2026-09-30 review decided the rep queue actions: reps cannot return an allocation, can release it to try a different player (the attempt is stamped against the prior player), and can 'request reallocation', which ops reviews and which needs mandatory notes. The only rep-queue ticket, WAGR-381, is Cancelled as out of scope, and WAGR-464 does not state these actions.
suggested_action: Suggestion: add the rep-queue actions and their note rules to WAGR-464 and create a build story for the rep redeposit queue; leave WAGR-381 closed with a link to the new story.
